name: RESTORATION_ELIGIBILITY_GATE
purpose: Reject unsafe or semantically underdetermined ROIs before any future restoration inference reservation.
decision_rule: All mandatory checks must be PASS; UNKNOWN or FAIL is HOLD and consumes no model budget.

checks.name: full_context_ui_fov_screen
checks.requirement: Review the entire native ROI and the full Canvas input for UI glyphs, logos, overlays, bright frame, gray fill, invalid FOV and dark-camera regions; checking only white-mask overlap is insufficient.
checks.evidence: original RGB, input Canvas, overlay-free contact sheet, explicit contamination polygons or exclusion mask
checks.threshold: No unresolved UI/FOV/overlay pixels within ROI context or required normal-metal reference; otherwise HOLD

checks.name: normal_metal_context
checks.requirement: Quantify independent, visually continuous normal-metal context on all four sides and inside the context crop, excluding the defect support, UI and boundaries.
checks.evidence: context mask, connected-region statistics, local luminance/texture summary and manual visual PASS
checks.threshold: Context must be sufficient for the intended edit and cannot be inferred from global image mean

checks.name: true_structure_boundary
checks.requirement: Determine whether the target crosses a physical seam, hole, edge, dark void, weld, repeated frame or other real structure boundary.
checks.evidence: boundary annotation and independent visual disposition
checks.threshold: Target crossing an unresolved real boundary is HOLD; do not ask inpainting to invent geometry

checks.name: native_information_and_scale
checks.requirement: Record native ROI dimensions, resize scale, effective content fraction and number of independent native pixels supporting the defect and context.
checks.evidence: frozen geometry transform and native/context pixel counts
checks.threshold: Extreme upscaling or tiny native information requires HOLD unless separately justified

checks.name: padding_and_mirror_risk
checks.requirement: Record padding mode, each side's padding width, valid-content fraction and whether reflected structures enter the model context.
checks.evidence: Canvas transform, padding overlay and mirror-boundary coordinates
checks.threshold: High padding fraction or visible repeated-edge structure is HOLD; no automatic acceptance

checks.name: mask_geometry_and_support
checks.requirement: Verify polygon/support hashes, full polygon coverage, white=redraw polarity, no mask in padding, no support overlap conflict and native round-trip identity.
checks.evidence: geometry validation JSON and deterministic mock
checks.threshold: Any mismatch is HOLD before model load

checks.name: pre_inference_machine_selection
checks.requirement: Persist selected source/ROI IDs, visual decision, all hashes and reviewer disposition before budget reservation.
checks.evidence: non-null machine-readable selection record with timestamp and provenance
checks.threshold: selection=null or post-output selection is FAIL

authorization_boundary: This proposal does not authorize a new model call or any training.
required_future_gate: ChatGPT/user approval of this protocol plus a fresh bounded run plan
